Hawaii’s 1905 mosquitofish import now linked to native species decline
description: The introduction of mosquitofish in Hawaii has dramatically affected the ecosystem, leading to notable declines in native aquatic insects. These invasive fish fiercely prey on local species, disrupting food chains. The native damselflies, unprepared for such predation, are particularly vulnerable, seeing their populations plummet. Additionally, mosquitofish compete with endemic fish and crustaceans for limited food resources, complicating control efforts due to intricate waterways and their fast breeding habits.

title: Why NHL players tape their sticks and how it improves puck control
description: NHL players tape their sticks for reasons that go way beyond hockey tradition. The tape changes the feel of the blade on the puck, helps prevent ice buildup, protects equipment and gives players a customized grip. From Connor McDavid to other NHL stars, individual tape jobs can be a reflection of playing style, comfort, visual preference, and well-established pregame routines.

title: IND vs SL: The ninety minutes! Moving day comes early in gloomy Galle

Devdutt Padikkal's 167 and a crucial lower-order stand kept India in control, but the pitch is beginning to offer the turn and bounce expected in Galle.

title: Brittany Mahomes explains why female athletes deserve more recognition

The former soccer player and Kansas City Current co-owner emphasized the impact sports can have beyond competition, including confidence, friendship and inspiration for young people. Her comments come amid wider debates surrounding women’s sports, though she focused on celebrating female athletes and ensuring their stories receive greater attention and recognition.

title: From burnt cash to possibly first impeachment: Justice Varma saga explained
description: Justice Yashwant Varma's residence was engulfed in flames, leading to the shocking discovery of burnt currency notes. A subsequent parliamentary inquiry confirmed serious charges against him, prompting his resignation. The Centre's pursuit of impeachment aims to set a strong precedential framework for judicial accountability. This case also poses critical questions about the interplay between a judge's resignation and ongoing disciplinary proceedings, potentially impacting future cases of judicial misconduct.

title: ‘Rankings don’t matter’: Pakistan captain’s bold India warning ahead of WC clash
description: Captain Abu Bakar Mahmood of Pakistan dismisses the importance of rankings as his team gears up for the high-stakes match against India. He believes that the actual performance will determine the winner on the field. After ten years without a win against their fiercest opponents, Pakistan are eager to advance to the World Cup quarterfinals, relying on a blend of youthful energy and seasoned leadership to reclaim their legacy.

‘Clearly, there’s something wrong’: Gavaskar questions India’s fitness methods

He points out that the spate of hamstring injuries suggests flaws in the existing training strategies. Furthermore, Gavaskar questions the rationale behind limiting bowlers' net sessions in the name of biomechanics, insisting that match fitness should take priority over purely gym-focused conditioning.

title: US immigration authority: These forms will be rejected from September 15
description: USCIS will introduce new editions of immigration forms I-539 and I-765. These revised forms will be effective starting September 15, 2026. Applications submitted using older forms after this date will be rejected. This change aligns with a recently published immigration rule. USCIS emphasizes there will be no grace period for this form update.

title: 'Stay away from politics': TMC leader Asish Banerjee's suicide note surfaces
description: Former Trinamool Congress MLA Asish Banerjee was found dead at his party office. A suicide note was discovered, which reportedly mentioned his political journey. Banerjee had served as a five-time MLA and held ministerial portfolios. He stepped down from a party committee after losing his seat. His body was taken for a post-mortem examination.

title: Elon Musk makes a promise to employees at townhall
description: SpaceX aims to enhance its AI model Grok by integrating insights from its workforce. Elon Musk envisions this initiative as a means to embed human values deeply into the AI's framework. Employees are not only invited to enhance the internal AI systems but are also inspired to share their expertise.

title: How fatherhood and his daughters changed Dak Prescott’s outlook on life
description: Dak Prescott’s journey into fatherhood has transformed how he views life, time and legacy. The Dallas Cowboys quarterback now looks beyond football and wants to experience every stage of his children’s lives, including seeing the families they may build someday. His perspective reflects the powerful impact of becoming a parent, especially after losing his own mother. For Prescott, success is no longer measured only by achievements, but by being present for family.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40B in medical debt; how mechanics work
description: MacKenzie Scott's donations have enabled medical debt abolition across America. Her model allows acquiring debt at low costs and then forgiving it. This approach has inspired other billionaires to contribute millions to similar causes. While philanthropic efforts are scaling, policy reforms for medical debt remain stalled. Scott's work highlights immediate relief possibilities and the need for systemic change.
